_provenance: The EXTRACTION economy (the mining faucet), sibling to economy.json (the market). The genome IS planet_layers' deposit numbers (abundance, mineral_frac, price) + a tool-cost lever, each bounded near physical reality. The simulated player is a GREEDY MINER who mines the best value-per-hour resource its tools can reach and upgrades when it can afford to; the economy survives that miner or it does not. Scored as the WORST of N regions (rule 7). GATES SET FROM A REACHABILITY PROBE (rule 1): the first objective gated share<=0.60, 3+ resources, and 800-25000 cr/hr -- 0/200 reached ANY of them (empty feasible region, no gradient). After a model calibration (reachable tools, wider profit band) and re-probing, gates sit just inside the reachable frontier and the maximizes (evenness/resources_mined/tiers_used -- positive, O(1), no ref-scaling trap) do the pushing.

walls.resources_mined: At least 2 resources MUST earn a rational miner real income, and the maximize pushes toward 3+. A resource economy where the greedy miner only ever digs one thing is a RESOURCE, not an economy -- the others are ghost content the world spent physics generating.
walls.top_resource_share: No single resource above 65% of income (the maximize on evenness drives it lower). Above that, the optimal play is 'dig straight to the one that pays' and every other deposit and tool tier is decoration -- the extraction-side of economy.json's Titanium-printer.
walls.tiers_used: Income MUST come from at least 2 tool tiers (the maximize pushes toward all 3). One tier means the shovel or the deep mine alone owns the game and the tool ladder is dead content. 3 tiers is unreachable in a 60h session (probed: 0/200) -- gated at 2, aspired to 3.
walls.progression_gain: The deepest tool reached MUST out-earn the shovel (>=1.25x) or there is no reason to upgrade -- but NOT by more than 12x, or the early game is a pointless chore the player rushes. Progression is a SLOPE, not a cliff.
walls.credits_per_hour: The faucet must pay enough to play (>=100/hr) but not be a money printer (<=3000/hr). BAND RECALIBRATED to the model's reachable range after the first objective set an impossible 800-25000 (p90 was 445). Below the floor is starvation; above the ceiling wealth is meaningless.
walls.hours_to_next_tool: The first upgrade MUST be reachable within 40 hours (999 is the sentinel for 'never'). Trapped at the shovel forever means the deep resources are permanently locked away.
walls.price_order: Diamond MUST be worth more per kg than copper, and copper more than iron -- reality. Forbids the optimiser from 'balancing' the economy by inverting physics (making iron a treasure). Tuned WITHIN reality, never against it.
